examples.detection_method: Deploy AI-based email content analysis tools that detect unnatural language patterns and metadata inconsistencies. Use DNS and WHOIS monitoring to flag newly registered domains mimicking enterprise brands. Analyze audio files with deepfake detection algorithms for vocoder and spectral artifact anomalies. Implement behavioral analytics to identify out-of-pattern wire transfer approvals and enforce out-of-band verification via phone calls or encrypted messaging.
